other_conditions: Must be a female domicile of Jammu & Kashmir and registered with Mission Youth, J&K.
Must be an individual woman or women entrepreneur where women hold at least 50% financial ownership.
Must be unemployed and registered with the District Employment & Counseling Center.
Must not be a defaulter to any bank or financial institution.
Can apply only once under the scheme.
Preference given to women trained at Rural Self Employment Training Institutes or Skill Development institutions.
If project cost exceeds Rs 5 lakh, the amount above Rs 5 lakh must be self‑financed.
Must not have previously received financial assistance for self‑employment under any government scheme.
Must establish the sanctioned unit within the period specified in the DPR.
Must not be employed in any government or public/private sector job during the loan tenure.
benefits_summary: Provides interest‑free financial assistance up to Rs 5 lakh, with an additional Rs 50,000 (or 10% of project cost) incentive and interest subsidy up to Rs 60,000 per beneficiary.
documents_required: Accounts statement certified by a Chartered Accountant
Indemnity bond attested by a First Class Judicial Magistrate
